items.problem: `GachaDrawResult.items` and the draw record share their `ItemAmount` objects with the `LootResult` list passed to `grant_gacha_result` (line 283), so a hook that edits a drawn item in place changes the drawn result. The spec says the draw records and the `GachaDrawResult` of the response are the drawn result regardless of the hook. Reproduced with seed 41 on `[gacha_banner_main]` and a hook that sets each item to `([gacha_shard], 5)` and returns those objects: the draw is `OK`, and both `results[0].items` and the `ListGachaHistory` row hold `([gacha_shard], 5)`. The drawn item of that seed is `([gacha_star], 1)` in `draw.test.ts`, where the hook returns a new list. The existing test does not cover this because its hook does not edit its input

`on_gacha_drawn` receives the same `draws.results` array that line 379 puts in the response, so a hook that changes it changes the response and no longer matches the saved draw records. Reproduced with a hook that sets `results.length = 0`, registered through a cast because the hook type marks the list `readonly`: the draw is `OK` with 0 `results` and 1 draw record
